basic_info.description: Architecturally significant Victorian,TOP FLOOR condo that lives like a single family! Saddling the highly sought after neighborhoods of Noe & Eureka Valley/Dolores Hgts. Two-level view condo with 3 bedrooms (all ensuite), 3.5 Baths,3 lg decks,2 car parking in a boutique duplex. Flooded w/ natural light this stunning condo was remodeled & structurally updated in appx 2006. (See 3R report). Lg scale floor plan has big rooms & high ceilings. Stone/Stainless gas kitchen, food bar,double paned windows throughout, wood floors, gas fireplace, skylights, outdoor space + great storage.  Living/Dining room & 2 beds/2.5 baths on the first level, along with washer/dryer & rear SE facing view deck accessible by French doors. The second level has a primary suite with large spa bathroom complete with double sinks, jetted soaking tub, & shower with 4 wall sprays, rain shower & handheld sprays! This bedrm has a home office area,w/ direct access to another rear-view deck w/French doors,walk to the front of this level to access the wet bar, wine storage cooler and a 3rd enormous front deck. Additional storage in the garage .The 2-car indep parking is located behind the duplex accessed from an auto opening gate. Walk to MUNI, Dolores Park, Noe Village, and close prox to 101 freeway
